room5_d6_r9_loc: That's it, listen to this hard worker. Otherwise it will be worse!
room5_d7_r1_loc: How long do I still have to wait? I'm tired of breathing dust. I hate this place.
room5_d7_r3_loc: Well, finally! So I came for you, as promised. Let's go, I'll ride with the breeze.
room5_d7_r6_loc: Dad... I don't want to leave. I'll stay here with mom!
room5_d7_r7_loc: What? You said it was boring here. And your whole life remained there: all your friends, toys, console.
room5_d7_r8_loc: Yes, dad. But here's mom. And she is dearer to me than all this. And in general, it’s no worse here than at home, it’s just that everything is... completely different.
room5_d8_r10_loc: Outrageous! What are you saying? Who screwed up my boy? Again you are with your...
room5_d8_r11_loc: I think it's best for you, Mister, to leave. And if you continue to offend Anna, I will have to use force.
room5_d8_r12_loc: Okay. But I’ll come back and we’ll talk completely differently, big guy
room5_d9_r1_loc: How cozy it is here now! Just like home, even better.
room5_d9_r2_loc: Son... I'm glad you didn't go with him... I was very afraid...
room5_d9_r3_loc: Mom. Well, where will I go without you? Without Sherlock and... new friends... In general, it seems that it’s not so sad here.
room5_d9_r4_loc: Maybe there will be more. We'll teach you how to saw and plan! Then you definitely won't get bored.
room5_d9_r5_loc: Oh, I completely forgot. Maybe this sign will help you read your dad's book?
room5_d9_r6_loc: It's like in spy movies! You need to put the table on a piece of paper and it will highlight the correct letters.
room5_d9_r8_loc: “I will leave something very valuable for you in our house, Anya. I hope it will help you in difficult times. Forgive me for everything. Dad.”
room5_d9_r9_loc: It looks like there are still many secrets in this house...
